benefits.text: BBIA Last Auto Eyebrow Pencil has a firm core structure that is easy to work with and needs no sharpening, letting you draw beautiful brows like a pro. Whether you want soft, refined brows or bold, natural ones, the product delivers. Notably, even after multiple strokes, brows still look natural, without clumping or becoming too dark, with a color that resembles real brow hair. The core contains a special powder ingredient that helps control oil on the skin, helping the line stay long-lasting and not easily wiped off on normal skin.

howToUse.text:
Use after basic makeup and skincare steps.
Draw your desired brow shape; you can draw hair strokes into gaps and brush the brows after drawing for a natural effect.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: Firm-core automatic eyebrow pencil that is easy to work with, helps fill in a natural brow shape and needs no sharpening.
